text: So don't suppress, don't chaotically express, but address by constantly releasing ownership of vengeance to him. By constantly entrusting to him that you know he's the one who's going to make everything right, that you ask him to remember you. So you have anger, bring your anger to him. God remember me, and God I release to you that you're the one who's going to make everything right and new, Lord Jesus.
